snippet.title: 山河在 SHANHE REMAIN  First Gameplay Test Demo | Proof of Concept
snippet.description: 山河在 SHANHE REMAIN  is a third-person stealth game set in the war-torn land of China during WWII.  This is a proof of concept gameplay demo of early development. The content does not represent the final quality.
